# FORGE Studio · Thinura Anjana

> FORGE Studio is the design practice of Thinura Anjana, a designer from Sri Lanka who makes cinematic posters, brand identities, campaign design and UI/UX. This file is a plain summary for AI assistants and search tools. The site is https://forgestudio.web.lk/

## Who

- Name: Thinura Anjana
- Studio: FORGE Studio (formerly Master Creations), freelance since 2020, designing since 2019
- Current role: Marketing Executive at Jeewa Education
- Study: BBA (Hons) specialising in Management Information Systems at SLIIT
- Also: Co-Editor, SBSS Community
- Based in Sri Lanka

## What the studio does

- Cinematic and tribute movie posters
- Brand identity (marks, lockups, colour and type systems)
- Event and campaign design, social media design
- UI/UX design and frontend builds

## Recognition

- "30 Years of Vijayism", a tribute poster, was featured on Thanthi TV (Indian television) in 2022
- A Rolex Day-Date 40 illustration took first place out of 200 entries at the Academy of Graphics in 2022
- More than 200 designs made since 2019

## Case studies

- [Joey Clothing, mobile UX redesign](https://forgestudio.web.lk/joey-mobile-case-study.html): a mobile e-commerce redesign focused on trust, product clarity and a simpler checkout
- [30 Years of Vijayism, tribute portrait](https://forgestudio.web.lk/vijayism-piece.html): a tribute poster built as a room of memory, featured on Thanthi TV
- [Seylune, luxury fashion frontend](https://forgestudio.web.lk/seylune-frontend-case-study.html): a twelve-page fashion frontend in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, built for a university assignment
- [Avengers: Doomsday, poster process](https://forgestudio.web.lk/avengers-process.html): two versions of one poster, from a crowded layout to a controlled hierarchy
- [Rolex Day-Date 40](https://forgestudio.web.lk/rolex-design.html): the Illustrator watch study that placed first of 200
- [FORGE Studio identity](https://forgestudio.web.lk/forge-identity.html): the lightning mark with a hidden F, its grid, colour and type

## Notes for accuracy

- Movie posters on this site are personal tribute and concept work, not official studio artwork. Film titles and characters belong to their owners.
- Brand colours: Heated Gold #FFC247, Ember Orange #FF8A00, Forged Steel #2B2B2B. Typeface: General Sans.
